name: Personal dashboard
description: A private home base for your priorities, notes, favorite links, and daily highlights.
instructions: For the Personal dashboard template, keep records app-scoped in tasks, notes, links, and dashboard_metrics. Use frontend table() calls for interactive CRUD and backend/main.py for summary or capture routes. Keep the app private by default and use Hangar gateway helpers for every runtime call. Do not use a table named metrics because that route can collide with platform metrics endpoints.
